request.spec:
The sheet has a fiscal year start month (settings, 1 to 12, 1 unless set, not dated;
SETTING_CHANGED key=fiscal-start-month value=<month>; anything else is refused). A fiscal year is
named FY<yyyy> by the calendar year its first day falls in; show on each period the fiscal year its
from-date falls in. A year entry and a button generate that fiscal year's twelve monthly periods
exactly as the period generator does; show how many were made.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The sheet has a fiscal year start month (settings, 1 to 12, 1 unless set, not dated;
SETTING_CHANGED key=fiscal-start-month value=<month>; anything else is refused). A fiscal year is
named FY<yyyy> by the calendar year its first day falls in; show on each period the fiscal year its
from-date falls in. A year entry and a button generate that fiscal year's twelve monthly periods
exactly as the period generator does; show how many were made.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The fiscal-year change is in, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the acceptance spec.

**The setting.** `fiscal-start-month` is a new setting that isn't tied to a date. Until it's set it shows `1`. It accepts whole numbers from 1 to 12, so `04` is saved as `4`. Anything else is refused and shows `settings-error`: `13`, `x`, and also a blank value. A good save writes `SETTING_CHANGED … key=fiscal-start-month value=<month>` to the audit file through the existing settings path. The backend changes are in `setting/SettingRepository.java` and `ValidateSetting.java`; the frontend changes are in `settings/api.ts` and `Settings.tsx`.

**FY on each period.** Each period row now has a `period-fy` cell showing the fiscal year its from-date falls in. For example, with a start month of 4, a period starting 2025-12-20 is FY2025 and one starting 2026-04-01 is FY2026.

**Generating a fiscal year.** There is a new year field (`period-generate-fy-year`) and button (`period-generate-fy`). They call a new endpoint, `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/generate-fiscal-year` (`GenerateFiscalYear.java`), which makes the twelve months starting at the start month of that year.
- It runs the same month loop as the existing period generator; I moved that loop into a shared helper in `GeneratePeriods.java` rather than copying it. So months whose name is already used, or whose dates overlap an existing period, are skipped, and each period made writes a `PERIOD_ADDED` record.
- The count shows in the existing `period-generated` element, which both buttons share.
- A year that isn't four digits is refused with `period-generate-error`.

**Decision for you:** I chose to refuse a blank fiscal start month instead of treating blank as "back to 1". The request says anything other than 1 to 12 is refused, but most other settings in the app accept blank to clear. The test doesn't check this either way, so it's a one-line change if you'd rather blank reset it.
